Re: Mrs Sierra Fredrick

Dear Dr sSmith,

I am writing to update you on the health status of Mrs Fredrick, who i believe she is a regular
patient at your practice. She is being discharged today after admission to our hospital two days
ago following a fall while descending stairs.

Ms fFredrick admitted via ambulance and was found on staircase screaming for help, for which
she was suspected to have a hip fracture. On examination, she was conscious, orientated as
well as competent. However, her MMSE score was 6.7 . Her other findings were unremarkable
except for a bruising on her right elbow and a nodular goitre . Imaging revealed osteopenia with
no fractures. Therefore, a referral to an endocrinologist for further assessment is recommended
if warranted.
